label: For "Clinical Communication Urgency Classification": Classify incoming clinical and operational messages by urgency and the response pathway they need, so the right queue sees them first, while deterministic emergency rules and existing escalation protocols stay in force. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Training on arrival-order labels.
